claim: The verified initial training dataset does not contain any formulation near the 1 MPa target.
Among tested regressors, the random forest is the strongest baseline for predicting Glass adhesion from monomer composition.
Hydrophobic, aromatic, and nucleophilic fractions are among the most influential variables for predicted adhesion.
Optimization rounds improved outcomes into the ~300–350 kPa range but still remained well below 1 MPa.
Design recommendations should be interpreted as extrapolations within the observed composition regime, not proof of achieving 1 MPa.
